newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian plane crashes on landing.
newsitem.headline: Russian plane crashes on landing.

text.p: A Russian passenger plane with up to 30 people on board crashed on landing in the Siberian town of Khanty-Maniisk on Saturday, a spokesman for the Emergencies Ministry said.
The spokesman was unable to say whether there had been any casualties.

He said the Yak-40 short-distance plane was damaged when it tried to land on the helicopter pad of the town's airport rather than on a landing strip designed for planes. It was not clear why this had happened happen.
